title: Security Threat Model (3 Flows + 12 Mitigations) & Cloud/Self-Hosted Infrastructure Diagram
acceptance_criteria: 09-security-model.md: Complete STRIDE Threat Modeling with Data Flow Diagrams (DFD with Trust Boundaries) for 3 core project flows: (1) Household Auth & RBAC Invitation Flow, (2) Atomic Recipe Cook & Inventory Deduction Flow, (3) Barcode External Lookup & Offline Shopping List Sync Flow.

09-security-model.md: Mitigation Plan Table for 12 Critical Threats detailing STRIDE category, CVSS v3.1 vector / severity, affected component, exact code/infra mitigation in .NET 10 / React / Nginx / PostgreSQL, and verification test reference.

10-deployment-model.md: Standard AWS/Cloud-style Infrastructure Architecture Diagram (Mermaid architecture diagram + scripts/generate_infra_diagram.py using diagrams.mingrammer.com) showing Public Zone (Cloudflare DNS/WAF/Tunnel), Tailscale Mesh VPN, DMZ/Ingress (Nginx Reverse Proxy), App Tier (.NET 10 API replicas, Background Worker), Data & Cache Tier (PostgreSQL Primary/Backup, Redis), and Observability Tier (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana).

10-deployment-model.md: Complete Resource Specification & Sizing Table defining CPU, RAM, storage, network bandwidth, container replica counts, and volume mount configurations for each deployment tier.
scripts/generate_infra_diagram.py: Standalone executable Python diagram generator producing visual PNG architecture diagrams corresponding to the deployment topology.
